features.fullDescription: Circa 1900. Steel bowstring of over 100' span between semi-lozenge piers of rock-faced red sandstone blockwork with crenellated tops, snecked rubble approach walls with walls with end dies. Bowstrings have three stays to outside, lattice parapets to inside and decorative wrot-iron scrolls at piers.
